about.title: About deVino

why.heading: Why deVino
why.body: The world is not short of clothes. Our question was never what else could be made, but why anything new should exist at all. Our answer was a woman whose presence never needs to raise its voice.

shoulder.heading: We Begin at the Shoulder
shoulder.body: Before designing, we watched the body, looking for the place where a person's presence appears first. We found it at the shoulder, the line we associate with endurance and standing tall. Every deVino piece begins there, and any detail that doesn't follow that line is left out.

name.heading: The Name: From a Cup
name.body: The name deVino grew from a familiar word that Persian defines as a cup: a vessel that means little on its own and becomes complete only when it passes to another hand. A cup belongs to gatherings, to evenings made whole by the presence of others. deVino is not the name of an object. It names the moment something passes between a woman and what she wears.

about.closing: Beauty is born of the relationship between a woman and her dress, never from one overpowering the other.

terms.title: Terms & Privacy
terms.intro: Your trust matters to us as much as the details of a dress. This page explains how ordering works at deVino and what we do with your information.

process.heading: How ordering works

steps.1: You choose a piece and fill in the order form.
steps.2: We contact you through the channel you chose (phone call, WhatsApp or Telegram).
steps.3: During that conversation, we finalize the size, shipping cost, delivery time and payment method together.
steps.4: Once you confirm and payment is made, your order is prepared and shipped.

process.note: Submitting the form alone is not a final purchase or a commitment to pay. You can cancel your order at any time before the final confirmation during our call.

items.1: Prices are in Toman. Shipping is calculated separately and shared during our call.
items.2: Our pieces come in sizes 36, 38 and 40. If you're unsure about your size, we'll guide you during our call.
items.3: Colors in photos may look slightly different depending on your screen.

items.1: What we collect: your name, mobile number, size, preferred contact channel, Telegram username (if you choose Telegram), and any notes you write.
items.2: Why: only to follow up on and fulfil your order.
items.3: Who sees it: we never sell or share this information with any person or company. We ask for your address during our call, and it is shared only with the person handling delivery.
items.4: Deleting your data: you can ask us to delete your information at any time through our contact channels.

stats.heading: Visit statistics
